_comment: Initial placements. Path is a zigzag from (-12, 0, -10) → (12, 0, 10). Each waypoint stores the velocity to set on enemies that touch it (toward the NEXT waypoint, magnitude = enemy speed = 2 m/s). Final waypoint is the base. Towers placed along bends.

initial_instances._: Path waypoints — tightened to z range ±7 to fit comfortably in ortho_size=10 view (vertical=20m). Each next_vx/next_vz is unit-vector × 2 m/s (enemy speed) pointing to the next waypoint.
The base — last node on the path. Enemies that contact it deal 1 damage and despawn.
Towers — placed along the path bends for coverage.
